subject: Draft: Onboarding playbook & MAP template for Ava Systems
messages:
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com
To: lydia.chen@avasystems.com
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2025-08-22T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: Onboarding playbook & MAP template for Ava Systems

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, I put together an initial onboarding playbook (MAP) and a short Week 0 slide deck to help align stakeholders and reduce ramp risk. Attached is a first-pass Google Doc template and a tiny slide stub.

Quick highlights in the doc:
- Week-by-week acceptance milestones (tech validation, security review, pilot criteria)
- Roles + owners (your side and ours) with a proposed weekly sync cadence
- Acceptance gates and example test prompts/data slices for evaluation

Action items I’m proposing on our side:
1) You to confirm main stakeholders (technical, security, procurement) and their preferred review window
2) We host a 30–45m MAP walk-through next Tue or Wed to lock dates
3) We add your security reviewer to the doc so they can annotate the data handling section

Attachments (stubs):
- MAP-Template-2025-v0.1.gdoc (Google Doc)
- Week0-Onboard-Slides.pptx (3 slides)

I put a lightweight timeline in the doc aimed at a 6–8 week pilot to production-readiness; open to compressing that depending on your constraints. I’ve cc’d Jasmine and Marissa from Success — they’ll help own the MAP details and the runbook.

Next steps: do either Tue 8/26 11:00–11:45 PT or Wed 8/27 9:00–9:45 PT work for a walk-through? If neither, tell me two windows that fit and we’ll flex.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood-inference.com

---
Attachment stubs: MAP-Template-2025-v0.1.gdoc (linked), Week0-Onboard-Slides.pptx (attached)

From: lydia.chen@avasystems.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@avasystems.com
Date: 2025-08-23T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Onboarding playbook & MAP template for Ava Systems

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround and the templates.

Couple of notes after a quick skim:
- Our security lead, Michael Ortiz (michael.ortiz@avasystems.com), needs to validate data handling + KV cache behavior. He’s on PTO until 8/29 but can carve an hour the week of 8/31.
- Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can provide a standard SOC 2 summary and the retention policy section needs a short plain-language blurb for our legal team.
- On timeline: we’re targeting a pilot start the week of 9/8, with a preferred production toggle by late Sept if everything looks good. That condenses the window; can you confirm Redwood’s minimal technical validation steps we’d need to sign off mid-pilot?

We can do the walk-through Wed 8/27 9:00 PT. I’ll invite Michael to the doc thread and procurement will join the walk-through.

Lydia Chen
Head of Product Integrations, Ava Systems
lydia.chen@avasystems.com

Date: 2025-08-24T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Onboarding playbook & MAP template for Ava Systems

Great — thanks for the read, Lydia. Wed 8/27 9:00 PT is locked on our side. I added a few notes to the doc to make the security and procurement sections explicit:

- Minimal technical validation for pilot sign-off:
  * Deploy model variant with representative prompts (subset provided)
  * End-to-end latency checks at expected QPS (we’ll share a short load harness)
  * KV/prefix caching validation for session continuity
  * Data egress + retention confirmation (we’ll surface the SOC 2 summary and KMS notes during the meeting)

- I added an Owner column and tentatively assigned: Jasmine (success lead) -> pilot acceptance checklist; Marissa -> stakeholder comms and demo scheduling; Kimberly -> procurement liaison (pricing/terms).

- Links: MAP doc (edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMAPTemplate/edit
- Week0 slides (view): https://drive.google.com/file/d/0week0slides

Jasmine and Marissa — can you confirm you’re comfortable with the condensed Sept timeline and whether we need more explicit test prompts in the doc? If Michael’s schedule is tight we can run an early security drop where we highlight the KV/cache/retention pages for quicker review.

Thanks — looking forward to the walk-through.

Rishi
